name: Clavicular's Clan

lead: Clavicular's Clan is a subscription looksmaxxing course run by the influencer Clavicular (Braden Peters). It was first called the Clavicular System and later renamed [1].
It offers guides on how to ascend, meaning become more attractive, and has been reported to suggest peptides to inject [1]. Its payoff is a structured plan of appearance tactics in one place.

paras: Members pay a monthly subscription, reported at about $50 [1].
Reported content includes peptide injection suggestions, which carry medical risks, and the program has drawn critical media commentary [1].

angle.text: Members get a bundle of looksmaxxing guides aimed at improving attractiveness.

lead: Clavicular's Clan is a paid looksmaxxing program sold by the influencer known as Clavicular, who began selling access in late 2025. It was originally the Clavicular System [1].

It is described as a self-improvement course with guides on ascending and suggested peptides to inject, priced around $50 per month [1]. Rolling Stone writer Charlie Sabgir wrote a critical piece titled around paying $49 for the academy, and Intelligencer's Ezra Marcus described the profit strategy as fusing shock-jock tactics with straightforward marketing [1].

paras: Critics quoted on the influencer's Wikipedia page say looksmaxxing content can expose young men to unrealistic beauty standards [1].

timeline.event: Peters begins selling the program, first as the Clavicular System, later renamed [1].
